title: Chen–Cheung's generalized Wilker inequality conjecture
statement:
For $0<x<\pi/2$ and $n\geq3$, let $B_n$ be the Bernoulli numbers defined by

$$
\frac{t}{e^t-1}=\sum_{n=0}^{\infty}B_n\frac{t^n}{n!},\qquad |t|<2\pi.
$$

**Chen–Cheung's generalized Wilker inequality conjecture.**

$$
\begin{aligned}
&2+\sum_{k=3}^{n}\frac{\big(2(2^{2k}-1)|B_{2k}|-(-1)^k\big)2^{2k-1}}{(2k)!}x^{2k-2}\\
&\quad+\frac{\big(2(2^{2n+2}-1)|B_{2n+2}|-(-1)^{n+1}\big)2^{2n+1}}{(2n+2)!}x^{2n-1}\tan x\\
&\qquad<\left(\frac{\sin x}{x}\right)^2+\frac{\tan x}{x}\\
&\qquad<2+\sum_{k=3}^{n}\frac{\big(2(2^{2k}-1)|B_{2k}|-(-1)^k\big)2^{2k-1}}{(2k)!}x^{2k-2}+\left(\frac{2}{\pi}\right)^{2n}x^{2n-1}\tan x.
\end{aligned}
$$

This conjecture extends the sharp Wilker-type bounds known for the first few terms of the expansions of $(\sin x/x)^2+\tan x/x$.
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/1602.00436

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of February 2016).
source_name: C. P Chen and R B Paris, “On the Wilker and Huygens-type inequalities”, arXiv:1602.00436 (2016).
